subject: Game Theory
title: Open Source Strategy
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Open Source Strategy.

hook.text: Google gave away Android for free. Why would a firm give away something worth billions?

buildup.text: Open source looks like charity. In game theory, it's a strategic move to commoditize competitors' products.

discovery.text: By giving away the OS, Google ensured its search and ad services reached every smartphone.

twist.text: The strategy only works if you profit from a complement. Android is free; Google Search ads are not.

climax.text: Open source shifts competitive advantage from the shared layer to the proprietary one above or below it.

punchline.text: Give away the razor. Sell the blades.

quiz.question: Why did Google give Android away for free?
options: To ensure Google services reached all smartphones
